description: Sequencer stepping one iteration of a chaotic map on each clock, with the logistic and tent maps to choose between

params.text: Sets the map's coefficient, the knob's 0 to 1 covering 2 to 4 for the logistic map and 1 to 2 for the tent map
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the R input before it is added to the coefficient
Chooses which map is iterated, logistic or tent, and the readout names the one that is set
Returns the map to its starting value of 0.61834

inputs.text: A voltage added to the coefficient, scaled by the slider for R, with 10V covering the knob's whole range at the slider's full setting
A voltage above 0.1V returns the map to its starting value of 0.61834
A rising edge runs one iteration of the map, reading high above 2V and low below 0.1V

outputs.text: The current value of the map, 0-10V
Carries 10V on the steps where the new value of the map is lower than the step before, and 0V otherwise

notes: the map is stepped only by a rising edge at CLK; with nothing patched there the outputs never change
